forecasts.outcome_definition: An AI system causes the extinction of humanity within the ten-year horizon beginning 2026-09-09. This is ARK's normalized wording; the cited source uses the broad phrase 'AI could kill all humans'.
forecasts.source_name: CBS News report quoting Evan Hubinger
forecasts.interpretation_note: Hubinger publicly stated a personal estimate of greater than 10% within the next decade. This is one individual's judgment, not an industry consensus, independently calibrated rate, or an estimate from ARK.
